payload.goal: Create employee Mariana Costa in Tripletex with contract details from attached PDF, including national identity number, date of birth, department, occupation code, salary, employment percentage, and start date.

Date of birth is set to 1999-10-22
National identity number is stored as 22109922602
Department Kundeservice exists and is linked to the employee

risk_notes: Sandbox is empty, so employer company Solmar Lda may not exist as context in Tripletex.
Department must be created first if not present.

ordered_steps: Check whether employee/payroll-related module is enabled; enable if required.
Create employee with name Mariana Costa, email mariana.costa@example.org, dateOfBirth 1999-10-22, and national identity number 22109922602.
Set employee employment details: start date 2026-06-08, employment percentage 100.0, occupation code 2511, employment type 'Fast stilling'.
Set salary details: salary type 'Fastlonn (manedlig)' and annual salary 510000 NOK.
Store additional employee fields if supported: bank account 51612021310, probation details, vacation entitlement.
Verify employee record contains all contract fields and is linked to department Kundeservice.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find employees corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.
